newsitem.title: CHINA: Beijing to control department store growth in city.
newsitem.headline: Beijing to control department store growth in city.

text.p: China's capital Beijing will halt or delay construction of some new department stores to try to regulate development of the fast-booming sector, the Xinhua news agency said on Friday.
Beijing now had 65 large department stores with areas of more than 10,000 square metres (110,000 square feet) each and had another 110 stores under construction or in the planning stage, Xinhua said.
Developers opened 17 stores in the city last year alone, the agency said.
"The current department store boom is characterised by redundant construction, too rapid growth and poorly-chosen locations," Xinhua said.
The chaotic development had lowered the profitability of such projects, caused big losses or even led to the closure of some stores, it said.
"The city...will delay or halt construction of some new department stores," it said. "The municipal government will impose stricter controls on new department store applications."
Such action would help coordinate development and avoid overlapping projects, it said but gave no further details.
